paperTitle: CancerSP: A Serious Game for Prostate Cancer Decision-Making and Planning Skills
centralContribution: This work introduces CancerSP, a prototype serious game designed to enhance decision-making and planning skills for medical professionals and students in the context of prostate cancer. The game replicates classic real-world prostate symptoms, treatment patterns, and care pathways, challenging players to concurrently manage multiple patients and make critical decisions to prevent patient fatalities.

elements.name: Central Contribution of CancerSP
elements.description: CancerSP is a serious game prototype aimed at improving decision-making and planning skills for medical professionals and students regarding prostate cancer. It simulates real-world symptoms and treatment pathways, requiring players to manage multiple patients simultaneously and make critical decisions to prevent fatalities.
elements.justification: This element directly states the core innovation and purpose of the paper, making it the most relevant conceptual element.

elements.name: Abstract Summary: Problem and Context of Prostate Cancer Education
elements.description: Prostate cancer is a globally common and increasingly fatal disease, highlighting the urgent need for early diagnosis and effective management. While computer games can facilitate healthcare learning, there's a significant gap in interactive tools specifically designed for prostate cancer decision-making and planning, particularly for simultaneous multi-patient management. Existing applications largely focus on awareness or symptom management, not complex clinical prioritization in a risk-free environment.
elements.justification: This provides a concise summary of the paper's context, the problem it addresses, and the rationale for the proposed solution, serving as the paper's abstract.

elements.name: Figure 5: CancerSP Game General Flowchart
elements.description: A high-level diagram illustrating the sequence of events, decision points, and different states a player experiences throughout the CancerSP game's progression, detailing the interaction between the Game Controller and individual patient states towards successful management.
elements.justification: This flowchart is crucial for understanding the overall game structure and mechanics, which underpins the paper's explanation of how the game guides players through an educational narrative about cancer.

elements.name: Figure 3: CancerSP Game Home Screen with Multiple Patients
elements.description: This image displays the Game Home Screen of CancerSP, presenting three distinct patient cases (e.g., Fred, Peter, Sam) simultaneously. Each patient shows initial data like Name, Age, Symptoms, and Family Medical History, central to the multi-patient management gameplay.
elements.justification: This figure illustrates a core part of the game's user experience, showing how players interact with multiple patient cases simultaneously, which is a key aspect of the game's innovative approach to decision-making training.

elements.name: Figure 4: Icon-based Action Buttons for Medical Procedures
elements.description: This image details the six icon-based action buttons available to players in CancerSP for diagnosis (PSA & DRE, US & MRI), intervention (Biopsy), and treatments (Radiotherapy, Surgery, Chemotherapy/Hormone therapy), crucial for player interaction.
elements.justification: This figure directly demonstrates the interactive elements and the scope of medical procedures simulated in the CancerSP game, validating the paper's objective of teaching players about prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment pathways.

elements.name: Figure 7: Funeral Scene (Patient Loss Consequence)
elements.description: This image depicts a funeral scene presented in the CancerSP game as a consequence of losing a patient's life, followed by a silent moment, designed to convey the serious impact of player decisions.
elements.justification: This figure is significant as it reveals a key emotional and didactic element of the game design, intended to convey the serious impact of decisions in cancer care and deepen the player's understanding of the stakes.

elements.name: Figure 6: Winning Scene (Successful Patient Management)
elements.description: This image shows a 'game over' screen from CancerSP, indicating a positive outcome where the player successfully saved a significant number of lives, reinforced by visual effects like awareness ribbons.
elements.justification: This figure highlights the positive reinforcement and feedback mechanism within the game, demonstrating how the paper's serious game design aims to motivate players through successful outcomes and reinforce learning about effective cancer management.

elements.name: Figure 1: Initial CancerSP Game Start Screen
elements.description: This image shows the initial screen presented to users when starting the CancerSP game, including elements like a title, game logo, and possibly 'start' or 'play' options, demonstrating the visual branding and entry point.
elements.justification: This figure demonstrates the user interface design of the CancerSP game from the very beginning, highlighting the visual branding and entry point for players, which is part of the overall game presentation.
